profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at DraftKings
profile.summary: I’m a full stack software engineer with over a decade of experience spanning Simulation, Video Games, and iGaming. My passion for video games started young with the Super Nintendo and N64. You could say I got my start from game modding. Browsing modding communities and various online tutorials I learned a lot about software and that really ignited my drive into a software engineering career. I have a B.S in Game Development from Full Sail University. I'm looking to continue growing into technical leadership, take on new challenges, and make a positive impact on people's lives.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Own platform-level deployment reliability across the full game catalog, acting as the escalation point for cross-team failures and coordinating DevOps, SRE, and partner studios to resolve systemic issues.
• Lead multi-team rollout and operationalization of GitOps, ensuring consistent jurisdiction launches and production readiness across regulated environments.
• Provide incident leadership for high-risk production events, including critical game rollbacks, mitigating downtime and external studio impact.
• Set CI/CD strategy and delivery standards for 80+ games, shaping epics, sequencing work, and aligning DevOps and external teams on modernization efforts.
• Mentor and guide engineers on deployment practices, risk reduction, and operational ownership, raising team-wide confidence and autonomy.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented the GitOps deployment architecture via Flux, reducing manual deployment errors by 30% and enabling 300+ game releases per quarter.
• Built and scaled KGB, an internal game-deployment orchestration framework, standardizing pipelines across 10+ environments and reducing release failures by 25%.
• Developed an AI-powered deployment diagnostics assistant, enabling engineers to self-resolve issues and cutting support tickets by 50%.
• Automated lower-environment and pre-production deployments, eliminating repetitive scripting and improving pipeline reliability by 25%.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Spearheaded live service efforts which includes decreasing user crash rates while coordinating smaller quality of life releases and streamlining processes for the content team. 
•	Launched a tournament system by defining technical design requirements and implementing the specifications which involved client, server and database redesigns.
•	Engineered a Front Office feature updating client views and server code to support the unlocking/acquiring a collection of items that provide users a boost to their lineup stats.
•	Incorporated the Apple DeviceCheck api on our game servers to validate users’ devices to reduce game botting and economy exploits by 40%.
•	Implemented support for data driven AI profiles in the Gamechanger tool allowing content creators ability to quickly iterate and design various styles of opponents.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
•	Built a native android app for instructors so that they are able to alter simulation conditions on the fly.
•	Developed a 3D component locator in WebGL utilizing the Unity Game Engine for the Chinook helicopter.
•	Rapidly prototyped mixed reality simulations for Microsoft Hololens using Unity Game Engine to confirm feasibility for existing virtual reality products.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
•	Created a network plugin for Unity using C++ so that all projects may communicate with existing hardware devices.
•	Modernized various Virtual Interactive Environment systems from Torque 3D using Unity.
•	Developed a Virtual Interactive Environment with a team of Artist and Subject Matter Experts using the Torque 3D game engine.

positions.title: Freelance Programmer
positions.description:
•	Developed an educational game for children in Unity3D
•	Created Black-box tests for other Software Engineers
•	Worked with a small team remotely to develop mobile games

projects.title: Sugar Rush
projects.description:
Student Project - Worked as Technical Lead / AI Lead
•	Created a Knowledge Based Behavior System to be used by enemies to respond accurately based on player actions. 
•	Generated Navigational Meshes from environmental geometry to be used by enemies to determine the direction in which they will traverse. 
•	Worked closely with artists, producers and programmers to help tackle a majority of the design and scalability issues. 
•	Made sure all integration to the project was smooth within all programmers by testing previous and all new features while debugging and solving any problems that occurred. 
•	Cooperated with team members to make sure they had the means to get their tasks completed.

projects.title: Ballistic Fist
projects.description:
Student Project - Worked as Sound/Effect Engineer 
•	Interfaced the Wwise API to control sounds in 3D space.
•	Developed the animation system to play VFX that were constructed from Maya using animated geometry. 
•	Incorporated Lua scripting to be used during Debug to balance game and make changes on the fly.
•	Utilized an Agile Development Model where sprint reviews determined action-items for future sprints.
